items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: You mentioned Baby Dodds and I mean I take it you knew him in New Orleans? ... Why sure, sure. Him and (Red Happy?) had a contest on my drums.

ctx.x: For Louis when Louis left him.
When Louis left. Because Louis told me, he said, man, he said, King Oliver sent for me this time. He said, man, I'm going. He says, because Dodds is playing drums.
Yes, but what I mean when he went with Fletcher. When he left you and went with Fletcher.
